svg.aria-label: Centromere prediction metro map: trimmed ONT reads (FASTQ) and an assembly (FASTA) pass preflight and environment solve, then two parallel routes scan for repeats (TideHunter plus cd-hit-est consensus monomers; TRF plus bedtools density windows), candidate regions are identified and decomposed per scaffold with stringdecomposer into a TSV summary, Markdown report and FASTA, with an optional chartz HTML charts spur
svg.title: Centromere prediction metro map
